title: T05 — compact J2 flange local contact / separation verification
geometry_basis: Final C2R1 compact J2: OD33 / PCD26.5 / 3xM2.5 / P007 flange t3 / P003 J2 zone t5 / pilot Ø14.10 / 16x1.5 gland.
contacts: P003/P007 metal mating faces: No Penetration, separation allowed.
Pilot/bore: locating function only; do not use it as an axial clamp support.
Do not mesh the O-ring in the first metal-release study.

load_cases.purpose: current upper candidate preload / release screen

seal_force_note: 0/300/600 N is a sensitivity envelope only. It is not a released FKM supplier compression-force value.
mesh: Local size <=0.20 mm at M2.5 receiver region, gland edge, pilot root and P007 flange root.
Repeat critical case with one local refinement and compare peak stress/contact opening.
outputs: von Mises stress in P003 and P007
contact pressure on metal mating face
release_rule: Target minimum static safety factor >=1.5 to the controlled material yield used in the study.
No gross face opening that unloads the static seal.
At 300 N/screw, existing analytical thread-strip screen remains >=3.10; FEA must not show a new local failure mode.
Result must be saved as controlled report and linked to the final CAD hash/fingerprint.
decision_after_run: If LC2 with 600 N separating seal reaction passes, retain OD33. If it fails only through local flange bending/contact, redesign locally before touching the rest of the module.
